answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to create a westward firing pass on B0100, using a sustained descending left turn as the opponent remained southwest and their separation narrowed; the ammunition drop and new missile support a launch, after which A0100 continued toward the missile’s west-southwest course rather than disengaging.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the apparent B0100 missile threat by preserving high speed and bending its northeast flight progressively north, making the near-altitude missile behind it follow the turn; the missile remained west and reached nearly the same latitude, while A0200 retained its weapon and avoided an offensive turn toward B0100.
